method: Raw contact sheets first, then cached-pose overlays and nine full-resolution 640x480 images. Approximate visible-joint regions are [x,y,radius] in original pixels, with uncertainty from blur/clothing. They are diagnostic regions, not precise GT, training labels or event scoring replacements. All unlisted joints are unassessed, never assumed visible. Anatomical left/right is tentative for side views.

coarse_phase_review.description: Moves toward camera then pitches forward. Head/arms leave bottom edge around landing. Onset is approximate; old prelocked scoring intervals remain unchanged.
Starts seated, leans and drops forward. Earlier lean is ambiguous; face and near arm leave bottom edge around landing.
Rises/leans from chair then falls forward. Initial rise cannot itself be labelled falling with certainty; head and arms leave bottom edge.

frames.visibility: Whole body in image; face and hip centers approximate under hair/clothing.
Strong blur; face and leg-joint positions uncertain/occluded. Both arms remain partly visible.
Head/nose and parts of arms outside bottom edge; body partly visible but joint identities uncertain. No precise coordinates assigned.
Near-side left arm/leg visible; far-side joints overlap; hip centers concealed by clothing.
Near left wrist approaches bottom border, lower leg partly overlaps chair. Far shoulder and far leg uncertain.
Face/nose and much of upper body outside bottom edge. Shoes visible, but left/right ankle identity uncertain. No coordinates assigned.
Most body visible; far arm and hips uncertain through overlap/clothes.
Motion blur; left wrist has passed bottom edge. Right arm remains visible; hip and far leg partly occluded.
Head/nose and most arms beyond bottom edge; shoulders clipped; legs visible but identity uncertain. No coordinates assigned.
